commonCanvasPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE full-screen, high-fidelity DESKTOP APPLICATION screenshot for the Chinese AI film-production workspace "片场". Landscape 1800x1120 proportions, screen fills the entire image, no perspective, device frame, presentation caption or multiple-page collage. This is a proposed visual design, not a marketing website. Crisp, polished Chinese typography. Readable controls, calm expertly aligned layout.
Use the supplied image only for the fictional story characters, cafe, key and functional scene scope. Redesign the interface with the specified visual direction; do not copy its typography or framing.
Shared functional content (must stay consistent across alternatives): A single cafe scene of "旧钥匙 / 第1集 / 咖啡厅", six shots. Compact 54px top context bar includes wordmark 片场, this breadcrumb, "镜头制作" active and "剪辑" inactive; right side "预览整场" and a quiet outlined "审阅稿 v1 · 待修改". Second compact 40px bar: "分镜模式 / 自由画布" with 自由画布 active, and small "素材 / 历史 / 助手" utilities at right. No large page title, statistics dashboard, subtitle or stacked filters. One thin left icon rail (about 56px) for project/assets/jobs/settings, compact avatar bottom. The assistant is collapsed.
The remainder is a free canvas with sparse nearly invisible dots, independent media and text nodes, no compulsory shot containers, no timeline. 2 shared reference nodes on left (林夏 · 人物参考, 咖啡厅 · 场景参考). Six scene shots distributed coherently in two loose rows: SH01 相对而坐 (two Asian adults sitting across cafe table), SH02 迟来的追问 (woman), SH03 欲言又止 (man), SH04 拿起旧钥匙 (close-up hand/key), SH05 被唤起的记忆 (woman), SH06 无声的回答 (two people). Film stills natural and not tinted by UI; no generic stock portraits. Include SH04 candidate A and a separate larger selected "SH04 · 候选 B" showing a subtle alternate hand-key action. A is labeled "当前采用 A"; B is "未采用", selection never means approved. Reference and historical derivation curves only, subdued and attached to outer node ports, never through photographs. No sequence arrows between independent shots.
A compact local continuation composer sits below selected candidate B without covering any imagery: title "基于 B 的新尝试", small reference chips, one short prompt "接触点更自然，保持右手拿起钥匙。", bottom model label "Seedance" and primary button "查看生成计划". No prices or real generation claims. Other node metadata minimal: shot label, title, play icon and short duration. Bottom left a compact pan/select/zoom/fit toolbar; lower center a quiet "全场 6 镜头" locator; bottom right small "已保存". UI frame plus editing controls should stay secondary to media.
Precision: no card-inside-card decoration, no giant pills, no gradients or glowing borders, no fake complex graphs, no sci-fi, no glossy chrome, no tiny dense filler labels. Native practical Mantine-compatible components, sober professional film tool. Keep a comfortable amount of blank canvas, consistent typography and optical alignment.

variants.name: A · 石墨沉浸
variants.style: Visual direction A: GRAPHITE FILM STUDIO. Uniform neutral charcoal environment. Canvas #111214, navigation #161719, panels #202124, thin borders #353638. Off-white text #E9EAEC, restrained secondary #A8AAB0. A very small pale apricot accent #E6BC87 exclusively for the main action and selected node edge; navigation active uses neutral light text and a fine indicator rather than large amber fills. No warm color cast across the whole UI. Precise humanist Chinese sans-serif 14-15px body, 12px metadata, medium 500 labels; 6px controls and 8px media corners. Very quiet inset headers, continuous canvas and minimal separated boxes. Contemporary premium editing-suite feeling, subtle enough to let the footage supply nearly all color. The selected candidate should feel like a carefully positioned working focus, not a giant management card.

variants.name: B · 瓷白编辑
variants.style: Visual direction B: PORCELAIN EDITORIAL STUDIO. A luminous almost-white application, canvas #F5F5F2, pure white node surfaces, neutral ink text #202622, fine warm-neutral rules #DCDDD7. Forest-green accent #315D4A, used sparingly for the main action and selection; pale sage selected control background. Crisp natural daytime readability and an editorial sense of spacing. Chinese sans-serif 15px body with generous line-height, 12px metadata, medium labels; no ornamental serif in controls. Canvas reads like a refined digital production desk, with media plates separated by gentle space, thin hairline frames and extremely weak local shadows. 4px controls, 6px image corners, restrained open typography. Not beige parchment, not a generic white admin dashboard, not a landing page. Left rail quiet porcelain, input panels white. Natural dark film stills supply rich contrast against light environment. All six shots and the same local composer remain.

variants.name: C · 明暗双域
variants.style: Visual direction C: DUAL ENVIRONMENT / PRECISION STUDIO. This is the CREATIVE side of a system whose management pages will be light. Use medium graphite canvas #242629, slightly darker top/side rails #1B1D20, neutral raised controls #32353A, white text #ECEFF3 and blue-gray metadata. A controlled cobalt #739DFF carries focused selection and the primary action, never neon. 5px square-ish corners, crisp 1px rules, flat compact tool groups, distinct but quiet control surfaces. It must appear noticeably more mid-gray and legible than a near-black cinema theme, with engineered clarity and deliberate alignment. Chinese sans-serif 14px, stable tabular digits, no uppercase technical jargon. Greater surface separation than A, less floating-panel softness, yet retain generous negative canvas space and the same content. Express premium precision through geometry, spacing and clear inputs, not metallic skeuomorphism. The logo mark and control grammar will repeat on an accompanying light project page.

commonProjectPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-screen desktop PROJECTS PAGE screenshot for the Chinese AI short-drama studio workspace "片场", 1800x1120 landscape proportions, no device frame/perspective, no marketing poster or mosaic. It must belong to the same complete design system as the provided scene-canvas image. Use that image as the visual-system and fictional story reference, not as a page layout to copy.
Page functional content identical for all visual directions: narrow brand/navigation sidebar with simple clapper mark and "片场", workspace "拾光工作室"; only "项目" active, "素材", "作业", "设置", and user avatar. Main header compact project page title "项目", a discreet "3 个进行中" summary, right search field "搜索项目" and primary "新建项目". No welcoming slogan, English eyebrow, KPI dashboard, pie charts, oversized hero or promotional writing. Content area identifies "最近打开", then THREE substantial project entries: "旧钥匙" (portrait of adult woman plus man in cafe, photoreal), "夜航" (photoreal cool blue train-window portrait of an adult woman in the rain, not same cafe), "回声" (photoreal warm DAYLIGHT coastal town with adult people, brighter than first two). Three entries have equivalent prominence, main project first. Short secondary text "第1集 · 咖啡厅", "第2集 · 站台", "第1集 · 海边"; subtle text status "制作中", "待审阅", "准备中". Include small member portraits and plain readable last-opened times; use realistic illustrative data with no performance claims.
Below, a compact open table/list "最近活动" with 3 rows and restrained dividers, clear columns "项目 / 内容 / 更新"; entries include "旧钥匙 / 咖啡厅 · 审阅稿 v1 / 12 分钟前", "夜航 / 角色参考更新 / 1 小时前", "回声 / 导入分镜 / 昨天". This is a real project landing workspace, not a marketing page.
Precision: establish an intentional hierarchy between large media, readable project names, metadata and quiet actions. Avoid outer cards around whole content sections, card-inside-card surfaces, random large gaps, too much heavy framing or small muted text. Chinese typography crisp and readable; full interface with practical Mantine-compatible controls. Keep the project page simple enough for daily navigation while premium in composition and spacing. No invented advertising navigation or advanced features.
